source: User's ninth Lab review (Lab v26.2.11, collision v26.2.11) on Chest-center-0004, run 5fda5626e808 (0-454 s, fps 6, Yolo26m-sem-HackEye26.1-48-1280.pt, 736p, depth da2-metric-outdoor-small, chest-center, user 1.78 m), collision re-run c2 (overrides source.mode map, ego.headingSource imu, horizon.source fused, ego.cadenceSource imu), reviewed 0-26 s: 16 correct, 1 incorrect, 5 'should not be said', 2 added. Kept in the repo because version bumps wipe Lab runs/reviews. One window w0 = 0-30 s of the run from its start (cold start). Arrays: grids, DA2 depth (68x120 float16 exactly as the run stored it: clearing the two lowest mantissa bits, as in the older fixtures, moves distances by up to 0.19 m and the replay stops being exact), 24 Hz motion incl. resid up to 36 s and the device sensors (keys sensors_*, the GoPro GPMF streams of the recording on its time line, up to 42 s). Why motion and sensors run to 150/156 s: the gyro bias is interpolated between the stationary spans of the whole motion track and the heading takes the GPS course; a bare 30 s clip finds no span (bias source 'lowest', -0.024 instead of 0.066 deg/s, no GPS) and the clocks shift by a quarter; the first spans/GPS needed lie before 150 s (120 s is not enough, 150 s is exact). Replay with speechRate 1.0 (the speech rate of the time; collision.json now says 1.25) and the default sound profile.
